bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Price Action Trading (PAT) analyzes bare price charts without indicators. Coulling critiques PAT because price action alone only shows historical activity; it cannot reveal future trend magnitude or whether a price move is genuine or a fakeout.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Price Action Trading (PAT) is a popular trading methodology focused strictly on analyzing bare price charts without technical indicators... Price action on its own merely shows what has already occurred.

facts.statement: Coulling states that if market legends like Jesse Livermore, Charles Dow, Richard Wyckoff, and Richard Ney were presented with a ticker tape showing price but omitting volume, they would have been struck dumb by the idea.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Imagine suggesting to Jesse Livermore, Charles Dow, Richard Wyckoff, and Richard Ney, that we had devised a new and exciting way to analyse the markets. The ticker tape print out would now ONLY show the price, but NO volume.

facts.statement: While candlestick wicks reveal intraday reversals in market sentiment, price action alone cannot verify whether the wick represents genuine institutional backing or a low-volume trap engineered by specialists.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: What of course this does NOT reveal, is the strength of this price action, and perhaps even more importantly, whether this price action is valid... This is why I feel price action trading only tells half the story.

facts.statement: Coulling describes the high-adrenaline pit environment of the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) at Walbrook and Cannon Street, where FTSE 100 futures were traded via yelling and hand signals before screen-based Globex trading shut down physical pits.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Living close to London as I do, and just a stone's throw away from The President, is the old LIFFE building, the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange.

facts.statement: Most physical pit traders failed to transition to screen trading because they were stripped of tangible sensory feedback—such as physical order flow, shouting, and money movement—leaving bare price action unanchored.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Without being able to see, judge, and feel the flow in the pit, most of these traders failed to make a successful transition to screen trading.

facts.statement: A physical auction lets traders observe buyer count, phone bids, bidding speed, and hesitations near spending limits; an online auction shows only updating prices. On electronic charts, volume acts as the digital equivalent of physical pit floor order flow.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: We have moved from the physical sale room, where we can see all the buyers... Instead we are joining an online auction... For us, it is the same. We simply use an electronic version of order flow which is the volume on our screens.

facts.statement: Regular Trading Hours (RTH) refer to official physical exchange hours (e.g., NYSE 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM EST). Globex, introduced by the CME in 1992, revolutionized derivatives by enabling 24-hour electronic index futures trading.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: generally referred to as regular trading hours (RTH)... The platform that really changed the game was Globex, introduced by the CME in 1992, since when virtually every futures contract can now be traded 24 hours a day.

facts.statement: Following Globex's 1992 introduction, the CME rolled out key E-mini contracts: the ES E-mini for the S&P 500 in 1997, the NQ E-mini for the Nasdaq 100 in 1999, and the YM E-mini for the Dow Jones 30 in 2002.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The platform that really changed the game was Globex, introduced by the CME in 1992, since when virtually every futures contract can now be traded 24 hours a day.

facts.topic: Neutralization of Open and Close Gaps
facts.statement: Because continuous 24-hour electronic futures trading allows index sentiment to be priced in overnight across global sessions, traditional opening and closing cash gaps have lost their historical significance as standalone directional signals.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: What this means, in effect, is that the opening and closing prices of the cash market are now far less important than they once were... sentiment for the cash market open is already known well in advance.

facts.statement: With continuous electronic trading neutralizing opening gaps, Volume Price Analysis has become even more essential for distinguishing genuine institutional accumulation and distribution from market-maker opening traps.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: All that is needed is to test out the price level at which to pitch the price for the opening few minutes... volume analysis has become even more critical to differentiate genuine institutional moves from market-maker opening traps.

facts.statement: Volume provides the third analytical dimension that allows traders to triangulate price action, verify market sentiment, and test the validity of technical chart patterns before committing capital.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume gives us our bearings, it allows us to triangulate the price action and to check the validity of our analysis.

facts.statement: During the opening minutes of a trading session, market makers utilize overnight Globex sentiment data to test price levels, using low-volume probes to gauge liquidity before driving the market in its true direction.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Remember from earlier in the book, that the futures index markets will have already been trading overnight on Globex, giving the market makers a clear idea of bullish or bearish sentiment. All that is needed is to test out the price level.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
